killedBy: the campaign board unlock (issue #983) refuses to launch a board the save has not unlocked -- the launch gate's backstop
why: The launch-gate place (issue #983): `resolveVersusConfig` stops refusing a concrete board the player has not unlocked. It is the backstop, unreachable while the four places in front of it hold, so only a direct call can see it -- which is why the unit case calls it with a locked concrete board and expects the exact message. Proved before its tests existed: SURVIVES at 0 of 20 in scope on the gate's own commit, then KILLED by 1 of 29, measured.
